newsitem.title: MEXICO: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.

text.p: USDA said Friday that steer calves exported to the United States from Mexico sold with a higher undertone this week.
Exports for the week were estimated at 6,000 head into Texas and New Mexico states, against 2,855 head last week and 881 head in the same week in 1996.
"Trade moderate, demand good. Around 50 percent of cattle crossed at Presidio (Texas) where the bulk of the trade took place," USDA said.
Prices for feeder steers weighing 300-400 lb were 92-102 cents/lb, for 400-500 lb they were 82-92 cents/lb.
Imports into Mexico of slaughter cattle were estimated to have totaled 3,000 head for the week, it added.
((--Chris Aspin, Mexico City newsroom (525) 7289530. E-mail at chris.aspin@reuters.com))
